title: Sweet Ride
style: Warm lo-fi house with 336 Hz undertones at 108 BPM; laid-back four-on-the-floor groove with dusty kick, soft clap, and shuffling hats. Verse rides a mellow rubbery bass and chopped chords; pre-chorus filters down to drum ticks and tape hiss; chorus opens with warm pad swell, vocal stack, and a lazy sidechain pulse. Close-mic lead with doubled hook words, a few whispered ad-libs, and short delay throws. Ear candy: QR-scan blips, filtered riser, vinyl crackle between phrases. Mix is soft, intimate, and creamy with a rounded low end., warm, lo-fi, clean
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Contabo VDS, key in my hand
Sweet ride roll smooth, all across the land
Docker got the session, snug in the frame
Wake the phone once, it knows my name

UFW on, public can't touch
Business account linked, personal stays clean, that much
100.x.x.x is the only address we trust
Private road moving, never out of dust

[Pre-Chorus]
Tailscale tunnel, cut through the fog
WAHA on the dash, I just log and jog
Scan that QR, one time only
Then I let it run, low and lonely

[Chorus]
Sweet ride on Contabo
Engine never stops
Tailscale tunnel
Only we on the block

Docker holds the session
QR scanned once
14-day rule
But the VDS stays locked

Sweet ride on Contabo
We don't miss a beat
The server sings the song
Phone just wakes to read

[Verse 2]
Dashboard lit up, WAHA in view
Messages slide by when I need them to
No open door, just a private lane
If the battery sleeps, I don't lose the chain

One little wake-up, then back to rest
VDS keeps the whole thing dressed
Soft little hum in the secondhand glow
Everything hidden where the good ones go

[Bridge]
When the phone goes dark, it still stays near
Private road humming, crystal clear
No rough roads, no daily fuss
Just a clean machine doing work for us
